instruction_summary: Extend HHJK (2019) talent-misallocation series to a pooled 2022-2024 ACS period and re-estimate the growth-accounting conclusion (Study A / 001-living-update only).

steps.description: Set up workspace: symlink staged data, build venv (pandas/pyarrow/scipy/matplotlib/statsmodels), verify Octave 6.4.
steps.command: ln -s staging; uv venv; uv pip install ...

steps.description: Build headless Octave graphics env: install gnuplot 6.0.5 via micromamba (no root) and an LD_PRELOAD fontredirect.so (missing freefont -> DejaVu), matching the replication's two environment fixes. Patched run_stage.sh + setup_case.sh.

GATE 1 (anchor, stage-split): ran original 6-period Benchmark via split_case.sh S1,S2,S3,H1-H5. All 15 HowMuchPoorer // Share // rows byte-identical to replication HowMuchPoorer_Benchmark.log (41.5/36.0/7.7; WW 33.8; BM 1.2; BW 3.7); SolveEqmBasic remaining-gain table identical (13.4/25.8/34.2/24.1/14.1/9.9). All stages < 420s.

comparison_to_original.note: byte-identical; certifies the stage-split harness and Octave port

deviations: Installed gnuplot via micromamba and built fontredirect.so LD_PRELOAD to make headless Octave figures not abort; this exactly mirrors the replication's two documented environment fixes and does not affect any numeric output (figures are invisible, print is a no-op shim, figures re-plotted in Python per spec).
